sha256-dos-manifest-v1:45bcef61a258bd51e.title: Battle Chess II: Chinese Chess
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:45bcef61a258bd51e.description:
A sequel to the original Battle Chess, this game takes on a more Chinese approach, both in the rules of the game and in the presentation.

Using a Chinese variation of the game of Chess, pieces like the Queen and Bishop are replaced by Counsellors, Ministers, and Cannon. Pieces behave differently than their European counterparts and even the board is set up differently. Two things remain the same: the ultimate goal of checkmating the opposing player's king and the Battlechess style animated battles that occur when two pieces contend for the same spot on the board.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:45ca1f65f021a9321.description:
From the author:
"The premise is that something caused a decline in Earth's natural oxygen. As the air thins, survival is difficult. Oxygen becomes scarce, and this leads to a war. Breath Pirates was the introduction to a hypothetical trilogy called The Oxygen Wars, which was never written. This is an all-text MS-DOS -based adventure game. At the time, I was very proud of it. Simplistic as it is in retrospect, I did far more in Breath Pirates than I had in my previous adventure games -- at the time, quite an achievement for me."

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:45c73da5017c600f9.title: Dark Designs I: Grelminar's Staff
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:45c73da5017c600f9.description:
In this fantasy role-playing game, an army of evil extra-dimensional creatures is building above the Gandolan mountains, threatening the civilized regions to the south. There is no army to defend the lands, but if a few hardy adventurers can find a magical staff in the castle of a long-dead mage named Grelminar, the gate can be closed and the invasion averted.

The player controls a party of four characters, each with some standard-issue attributes: Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Piety, Body Points and Magic Points. The game also features three of the usual character classes (fighters, mages and priests), and there are different spell lists for each of the spell-casting classes. Players can create their own characters or use the ones provided by the game; either way, progress is automatically saved from time to time (though there is a reset button which allows the player to start over from the beginning).

The game starts out in a town (which is portrayed simply by a text-based menu system) and then proceeds into a multi-level dungeon. While exploring the dungeon, different areas of the screen display different information. There is a first-person, ninety-degree-turning view, an automap and, in some areas, a textual description. These are supplemented by random third-person, turn-based combat encounters which take place in the window that normally shows the 3-D dungeon view. In typical role-playing style, combat yields rewards of gold and experience (and sometimes equipment), and characters gain in abilities as they increase in experience.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:457f46991b47e7f91.title: Gridfighter 3D
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:457f46991b47e7f91.description:
This fast-paced 3D shooter is intended for VR headgear (although it can also be played without it). Even under DOS, it offers specific support for 'period-correct' 1990s headsets (Forte VFX1) as well as more modern ones (Oculus Rift DK1), but any brand/model should theoretically work as long as it can render stereoscopic images side by side. Using an abstract stripped-down graphical style, the action takes place in a cubical grid. The player controls a yellow triangle who's being menaced by a squadron of squares; player and enemies alike can move through the playfield in six directions.

The pointy protagonist shoots backwards and forwards simultaneously, and your score rewards are higher if you can zap more bad guys with a single shot. The enemies will unrelentingly chase you around the screen and do their best to hunt you down - and every few seconds their movement and spawning speeds are kicked up a notch, so your survival becomes a tougher proposition rather quickly.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:45bf9291f0236030d.title: Hex
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:45bf9291f0236030d.description: Hex is a computer translation of the strategy game of the same name: a 11x11 grid of hexagonal cells makes up the four-sided game board; each of the two players (black and white) is assigned a pair of opposing sides. The white player moves first, and both challengers take turns placing pieces on the board. To win, either player must form an unbroken sequence of pieces connecting their two colored sides. Hex may be played human vs. human or human vs. machine, plus a demo mode which lets you watch as two machine opponents match wits with one another.

But banal direct contact is not the only way to send jewels to the piggy bank, because the player is also allowed to shoot. With the help of manufactured shells, it is possible both to destroy blocks, which is often a prerequisite for overcoming a certain section, and to get the desired stones at your disposal. Of course, everything here is not as simple as it might seem at first glance - there will be obstacles, such as deadly spikes or unbreakable map elements.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:45ae8df0476a17085.title: Numbers and Logic
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:45ae8df0476a17085.description:
Numbers & Logic I is a single-player, shareware compendium of three puzzle games. The puzzles in this game are:

* Maze 8: where the player is presented with a hexagonal grid in which each cell contains a number from one to nine. The objective is to find the path that connects the left and right sides of the grid that totals the least.

* Find 9: this is played on a 16x11 grid where each cell contains the numbers from one to nine. The objective is to find 3x3 areas within that grid where no number is repeated

* Dial 10: this game consists of four concentric circles which the player must rotate so that the numbers one to ten appear once only in each quadrant

All games played using the mouse and are timed and the eight fastest times are listed on the high score table.
